query.en: Use the Asimov × Interstellar Deck template to turn my content into a cinematic 5-slide horizontal deck with deep navy/charcoal canvas, warm amber accent (oklch(72% 0.15 70)), serif italic emphasis, and a single distant 'anomaly' light. Cover · Timeline · Three pillars · Quote/closing rhythm.
